text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus brilliantly triumphed in the 
mile showdown despite the immense size 
difference. The venue erupted in cheers at 
the petite hero's sensational performance.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A Hollywood movie director who had come to 
watch the race was captivated by Biko 
Pegasus's running. He said he wanted to 
make a movie about her someday.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus shared a message with the 
fans who came to cheer for her: It was 
precisely because she never gave up, 
despite her small size, that she was able 
to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As long as you keep fighting to the very 
end, anyone can become a hero. Biko 
Pegasus proved just that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
On this day, Biko Pegasus became a true 
hero whom everyone looked up to.
